opening.comment: The agent gave only the company name and did not give their own name, so the greeting falls short of the scorecard.

verification.quote:
Agent: Name and order number or postcode.
Customer: Ahmed Bakker, order 804257.
verification.comment: The agent confirmed the caller's full name and order number before discussing the order, which meets the standard.

understanding.quote: Agent: Okay, Ahmed. Order 804257, a lamp at €44.50, in transit for 12 working days. So nothing at all has arrived?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue accurately and did not re-ask for details the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: Right. I've opened a lost parcel investigation. It closes within 5 working days and then we send a replacement within 3 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The timelines match policy, since the investigation applies after 10 working days without delivery and the caller had waited 12.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: I'm putting you on hold.
process_compliance.comment: The agent placed the caller on hold without asking permission first and did not thank them on return, so the hold step was missed.

communication.quote:
Customer: My parcel never arrived. It's been 12 working days and I'm absolutely furious, this is the second time.
Agent: Name and order number or postcode.
communication.comment: The caller said they were absolutely furious, but the agent never acknowledged the frustration and gave no apology, which falls short.

closing.quote: Agent: You'll get an email when the investigation closes. Is there anything else I can help with?
closing.comment: The agent confirmed the next step and asked if there was anything else, then closed politely, which meets the standard.
